$comment: earmilk colorways. Source: the README's Colorways table and Amendments, and the Flavors artboard on the canvas. Hex, sRGB. 'order' is the lineup order. Since 2026-10-02 there is no sleeve: 'board' is the body finish and 'print' the accent finish. 'lid' is 'print' where the gable and fin take the accent colour and 'board' where they stay the body colour. 'plinth' is the built-in 110 mm base in the accent colour; 'badge' is the metal wordmark on its front. Values under 'asDrawn' are read off the canvas illustrations and are reference only.

chocolate.name: Chocolate
chocolate.throatNote: 2026-10-06, the owner: dark, from the body brown at the mouth to a dark chocolate at the throat (was cream #E2CBA3 to tan #A97E4F, which read paler than the face around it)
chocolate.factsInkNote: 2026-10-07: the printed Facts in the cream print colour on the brown body

oat.name: Oat
oat.factsInkNote: 2026-10-07: the printed Facts in the brown print colour

rules: No sleeve: the colours are a finish on the birch cabinet, fixed per speaker.
Whole, 2% and Skim carry the gable and fin in the accent colour; Chocolate and Oat stay one colour, gable included.
The bottom 110 mm is a built-in plinth in the accent colour on all four sides, with a 3 mm shadow line above it.
The wordmark is cast metal lettering standing on the plinth's front, no plate, and the same letters on the back above the Nutrition Facts. Nothing on the sides, nothing under the gable.
Bare birch shows only in the bowl's exploded or section views.
The throat is painted, light at the mouth to dark at the throat. A polished stainless lip rings the mouth (2026-10-06).
Flavor is the colorway only. One voicing.

Three printed marks are spec: OPEN OTHER SIDE on the back slope, SHAKE WELL on the plinth's back, and the Nutrition Facts on the back (2026-10-07), all sealed under the clear. Nothing else is printed.

plinth.finish: accent colour, all four sides, flush with the body

badge.onLightPlinths: 2026-10-06, the owner: dark bronze letters on the light plinths (Chocolate's cream, Skim's pale blue), set per flavour under plinth.letters; polished on the others

lip.where: round the bowl's mouth on the front slope, floorstander and pint
lip.finish: polished stainless, the same on every flavour
lip.section: half-round over the finish's cut edge and the bowl's joint: 4.8 mm wide and 1.6 mm proud on the floorstander, scaled on the pint

backPanel.bronze: an engraved bronze plate, the Facts panel plus a 26 mm margin (x 36 to 354, z 484 to 796), 3 mm thick, 1.5 mm proud; port, posts and the cast letters on the finish outside it (default 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-06; withdrawn 2026-10-07)
backPanel.label: the same extent as a bare birch field (option)
backPanel.full: a bare birch field x 26 to 364, z 140 to 830 (option)
backPanel.print: 2026-10-07, the owner: no plate. The Nutrition Facts panel (266 x 260, top at z 770) printed directly on the back's finish, like a carton's, in the flavour's Facts ink (see 'facts'), on the cured colour coat and sealed under the 2K clear, so it cannot scratch off without cutting through the clear

backBadge.type: cast metal letters, as the front

openOtherSide.where: back slope of the gable, centred
openOtherSide.ink: the gable's other colour: board on the white flavours, accent on Chocolate and Oat

shakeWell.where: the plinth's back face, centred at z 55

facts.where: the back, 266 x 260, top at z 770
the back, centred, 266 x 260 mm, top at z 770; the cast letters above it, the port below
facts.ink: #1E1A17, a warm near-black, on the white flavours; the flavour's factsInk where it has one (Chocolate cream, Oat brown)
facts.process: printed on the cured colour coat (screen print with a catalysed ink, or a water-slide decal), then buried under the 2K clear and flatted level, as guitar headstock logos are
